frontmatter.title: Transforming lead nurturing: designing an AI-driven prospecting agent for customer home builder and real estate companies.
frontmatter.synopsis: Sales reps spent hours writing personalized outreach that rarely got replies, while a costly BPO team tried to compensate. Lead validation efforts on whether AI could replace or augment that team, and through three small experiments, found why a fully-automated agent wouldn't work, pivoting the project to a human-in-the-loop system before engineering committed resources.

frontmatter.title: Improve work efficiency and reduce information loss by helping non-tech savvy users connect their email inbox to Digima.
frontmatter.synopsis: Despite the fact that over 1.7 million emails were sent monthly thought the application, leads replies were not registered, leading to inefficiencies and loss of valuable information for our users.
